about: Markets with a precomputed Weather Records & Milestones pack (tools/build-insights.js). record: the official record the facts come from (threaded = the city's official record joining stations over time; station = one station). normals: the station whose 1991-2020 normals apply. ghcnd: the current observing station in NCEI GHCN-Daily, used to tell final from preliminary.

record.segments: Downtown city office 1871 to Mar 1915; Abbe Observatory Apr 1915 to Mar 1947; CVG airport from Apr 1947 (identical to CVG from then on)
